// Test-only adapter; resolveProps itself is unchanged.
func PortPropsOutline(tokens []*cst.Token,flow,indicator string,next *cst.Token,offset,parentIndent int,newline bool) string {
    hex := func(units []uint16) string { var b strings.Builder;for _,u:=range units { fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%04x",u) };return b.String() }
    describe := func(token *cst.Token) string { if token==nil {return "-"}; return fmt.Sprintf("%s,%d,%s",token.Type,token.Offset,hex(token.Source)) }
    errors,warnings:=[]string{},[]string{}
    onError:=func(source any,code,message string,warning bool) {
        pos:=getErrorPos(source);text:=fmt.Sprintf("%d,%d,%s,%s",pos[0],pos[1],code,hex(stringToUnits(message)))
        if warning {warnings=append(warnings,text)} else {errors=append(errors,text)}
    }
    result:=resolveProps(tokens,resolvePropsOptions{flow:flow,indicator:indicator,next:next,offset:offset,parentIndent:parentIndent,startOnNewline:newline,onError:onError})
    flag:=func(value bool)int{if value{return 1};return 0}
    return fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%d|%s|%d|%s|%s|%s|%d|%d|%s|%s",describe(result.comma),describe(result.found),flag(result.spaceBefore),hex(stringToUnits(result.comment)),flag(result.hasNewline),describe(result.anchor),describe(result.tag),describe(result.newlineAfterProp),result.end,result.start,strings.Join(errors,";"),strings.Join(warnings,";"))
}
